Predicción de inicio de Fibrilación Auricular (PAF) en AFPDB usando features CUSUM + Regresión Logística¶

Dataset: PhysioNet PAF Prediction Challenge Database (AFPDB)
Objetivo (estilo paper): extraer características basadas en variabilidad de RR y detección de cambios (CUSUM) y evaluar un clasificador simple (Logistic Regression) con particionado por pares (pair_id) y validación por grupos.

Nota: este notebook está organizado para ejecutarse con Restart & Run All sin depender del orden manual de celdas.

Extension SPC+ ligera¶

Esta version toma el notebook base y anade un bloque controlado de 8 features nuevas con buena trazabilidad fisiologica/operativa, pero sin llamar a la extraccion pesada del repo:

  • max_cusum_pos
  • max_cusum_neg
  • final_cusum_pos
  • final_cusum_neg
  • subwindow_sqi_good_frac
  • rr_cv
  • rr_masd_over_mean
  • segment_rr_mad_ms

La idea es mantener:

  • explicabilidad para medicos
  • una narrativa SPC clara
  • una ablacion honesta contra el set original del notebook
  • tiempos de corrida mucho menores que la variante SPC_plus

El notebook original no se modifica. Este archivo es la variante enriquecida ligera.

1. Configuración y dependencias¶

Este notebook usa wfdb para leer registros/annotaciones y scikit-learn para el modelo.
Si estás en un entorno limpio, instala dependencias (una sola vez) y reinicia el kernel.

2. Dataset (AFPDB)¶

Se descargan los archivos de AFPDB en el directorio local ./afpdb/ si no existen.
Si ya lo tienes descargado, esta celda no vuelve a bajar nada.

In [3]:
# Descarga AFPDB si no existe localmente (con manejo robusto de errores)
import time

DL_DIR = "afpdb"
os.makedirs(DL_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Heurística: si hay archivos .hea, asumimos que ya está descargado.
has_headers = any(fn.endswith(".hea") for fn in os.listdir(DL_DIR))

if not has_headers:
    print("Descargando AFPDB desde PhysioNet (wfdb.dl_database)...")
    max_retries = 3
    retry_count = 0
    
    while retry_count < max_retries:
        try:
            wfdb.dl_database("afpdb", dl_dir=DL_DIR)
            print("✓ Descarga completada exitosamente.")
            break
        except Exception as e:
            retry_count += 1
            if retry_count < max_retries:
                wait_time = 5 * retry_count
                print(f"⚠ Error de descarga (intento {retry_count}/{max_retries}): {type(e).__name__}")
                print(f"  Esperando {wait_time}s antes de reintentar...")
                time.sleep(wait_time)
            else:
                print(f"✗ Error después de {max_retries} intentos: {e}")
                print("  NOTA: Los archivos ya están parcialmente en ./afpdb/")
                print("  Continuando con los archivos disponibles...")
else:
    print("✓ AFPDB ya existe localmente. No se descarga de nuevo.")
    hea_count = sum(1 for fn in os.listdir(DL_DIR) if fn.endswith(".hea"))
    print(f"  Encontrados {hea_count} archivos .hea")

3. Métodos: extracción de características¶

Funciones principales: lectura de QRS, RR, RMSSD por ventanas, z-score robusto, CUSUM bilateral y generación de features por registro.

def load_record_and_qrs(record_name, pn_dir='afpdb'):
    """
    Loads a PhysioNet record and its QRS annotations.

    Args:
        record_name (str): The name of the record to load.
        pn_dir (str, optional): The PhysioNet database directory. Defaults to 'afpdb'.

    Returns:
        tuple: A tuple containing:
            - record (wfdb.Record): The loaded record object.
            - fs (int): The sampling frequency of the record.
            - qrs_samples (np.array): An array of QRS sample indices.
    """
    # Read the record and its sampling frequency
    record = wfdb.rdrecord(record_name, pn_dir=pn_dir)
    fs = record.fs

    # Read QRS annotations
    annotation = wfdb.rdann(record_name, extension='qrs', pn_dir=pn_dir)
    qrs_samples = annotation.sample

    return record, fs, qrs_samples

# --- Function: compute_rr_ms ---
def compute_rr_ms(qrs_samples, fs):
    """
    Calculates RR intervals in milliseconds from QRS sample indices.

    Args:
        qrs_samples (np.array): Array of QRS sample indices.
        fs (int): Sampling frequency in Hz.

    Returns:
        np.array: RR intervals in milliseconds.
    """
    # Calculate differences between consecutive QRS sample indices
    rr_samples = np.diff(qrs_samples)

    # Convert RR intervals from samples to seconds
    rr_seconds = rr_samples / fs

    # Convert RR intervals from seconds to milliseconds
    rr_ms = rr_seconds * 1000

    return rr_ms

# --- Function: window_rmssd ---
def window_rmssd(rr_ms: np.ndarray, rr_time_s: np.ndarray, window_sec: int = 30) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """
    Calculates RMSSD in non-overlapping time windows.

    Args:
        rr_ms (np.ndarray): Array of RR intervals in milliseconds.
        rr_time_s (np.ndarray): Array of cumulative time points (in seconds) corresponding to the end of each RR interval.
        window_sec (int, optional): The duration of each window in seconds. Defaults to 30.

    Returns:
        tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]: A tuple containing:
            - rmssd_values (np.ndarray): Array of RMSSD values for each window.
            - window_center_times (np.ndarray): Array of central time points (in seconds) for each window.
    """
    rmssd_values = []
    window_center_times = []

    current_window_start_time = 0.0
    # Determine the maximum time from the RR interval end times
    max_time = rr_time_s[-1] if len(rr_time_s) > 0 else 0.0

    # Iterate through the data in non-overlapping windows
    while current_window_start_time < max_time:
        current_window_end_time = current_window_start_time + window_sec

        # Find indices of RR intervals whose end time falls within the current window
        indices_in_window = np.where(
            (rr_time_s >= current_window_start_time) &
            (rr_time_s < current_window_end_time)
        )[0]

        # Check if there are enough RR intervals in the window for RMSSD calculation
        if len(indices_in_window) > 1: # RMSSD requires at least 2 RR intervals (1 difference)
            rr_in_window = rr_ms[indices_in_window]

            # Calculate the differences between successive RR intervals
            diff_rr = np.diff(rr_in_window)

            # Calculate RMSSD if there's at least one difference
            if len(diff_rr) > 0:
                rmssd = np.sqrt(np.mean(diff_rr ** 2))
                rmssd_values.append(rmssd)
            else:
                rmssd_values.append(np.nan) # Not enough data for a valid RMSSD
        else:
            rmssd_values.append(np.nan) # Not enough data for a valid RMSSD

        # Append the center time of the current window
        window_center_times.append(current_window_start_time + window_sec / 2)

        # Move to the start of the next non-overlapping window
        current_window_start_time = current_window_end_time

    return np.array(rmssd_values), np.array(window_center_times)

# --- Function: robust_z ---
def robust_z(rmssd_series: np.ndarray, baseline_windows: int = 10) -> np.ndarray:
    """
    Calculates robust z-scores for a series of RMSSD values.

    The robust z-score is calculated using the median and Median Absolute Deviation (MAD)
    of the first `baseline_windows` valid RMSSD values as the baseline.

    Args:
        rmssd_series (np.ndarray): Array of RMSSD values (can contain NaNs).
        baseline_windows (int, optional): Number of initial valid windows to use for
                                         calculating the baseline median and MAD. Defaults to 10.

    Returns:
        np.ndarray: Array of robust z-scores, with NaNs where RMSSD values were NaN
                    or if a valid baseline could not be established.
    """
    # Ensure rmssd_series is a numpy array
    rmssd_series = np.asarray(rmssd_series)

    # Identify valid RMSSD values
    valid_rmssd_indices = ~np.isnan(rmssd_series)
    valid_rmssd_values = rmssd_series[valid_rmssd_indices]

    # Check if there are enough valid values for a baseline
    if len(valid_rmssd_values) < baseline_windows:
        # print(f"Warning: Not enough valid RMSSD values ({len(valid_rmssd_values)}) to establish a baseline of {baseline_windows} windows.")
        return np.full_like(rmssd_series, np.nan)

    # Extract baseline values
    baseline_values = valid_rmssd_values[:baseline_windows]

    # Calculate baseline median and MAD
    baseline_median = np.median(baseline_values)
    baseline_mad = median_abs_deviation(baseline_values)

    # Fallback for zero MAD to prevent division by zero
    if baseline_mad == 0:
        # Set a small epsilon to avoid division by zero
        epsilon = 1e-6
        baseline_mad = epsilon
        # print(f"Warning: Baseline MAD was zero, set to {epsilon} to avoid division by zero.")

    # Initialize z_scores array with NaNs
    z_scores = np.full_like(rmssd_series, np.nan, dtype=float)

    # Compute robust z-score for each valid RMSSD value
    if baseline_mad != 0:
        z_scores[valid_rmssd_indices] = (rmssd_series[valid_rmssd_indices] - baseline_median) / baseline_mad

    return z_scores

# --- Function: cusum_bilateral ---
def cusum_bilateral(z: np.ndarray, k: float = 0.5, h: float = 7, sustained_windows: int = 2) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """
    Applies the bilateral CUSUM algorithm to detect sustained changes in z-scores.

    Args:
        z (np.ndarray): Array of robust z-scores.
        k (float, optional): Drift parameter. Defaults to 0.5.
        h (float, optional): Threshold for alarm. Defaults to 7.
        sustained_windows (int, optional): Number of consecutive windows required
                                         for a sustained alarm. Defaults to 2.

    Returns:
        tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]: A tuple containing:
            - Splus (np.ndarray): Cumulative sum for upward deviations.
            - Sminus (np.ndarray): Cumulative sum for downward deviations.
            - alarms (np.ndarray): Boolean array indicating detected alarms.
    """
    n = len(z)
    Splus = np.zeros(n)
    Sminus = np.zeros(n)
    alarms = np.full(n, False, dtype=bool)

    current_Splus = 0.0
    current_Sminus = 0.0
    consecutive_splus_alarms = 0
    consecutive_sminus_alarms = 0

    for i in range(n):
        # Handle NaN values in z
        if np.isnan(z[i]):
            Splus[i] = np.nan
            Sminus[i] = np.nan
            consecutive_splus_alarms = 0
            consecutive_sminus_alarms = 0
            continue

        # Update Splus
        current_Splus = max(0, current_Splus + z[i] - k)
        Splus[i] = current_Splus

        # Update Sminus
        current_Sminus = max(0, current_Sminus - z[i] - k)
        Sminus[i] = current_Sminus

        # Check for individual alarms
        is_splus_alarm = current_Splus > h
        is_sminus_alarm = current_Sminus > h

        # Track consecutive alarms for Splus
        if is_splus_alarm:
            consecutive_splus_alarms += 1
        else:
            consecutive_splus_alarms = 0

        # Track consecutive alarms for Sminus
        if is_sminus_alarm:
            consecutive_sminus_alarms += 1
        else:
            consecutive_sminus_alarms = 0

        # If a sustained alarm is detected, mark the current and preceding windows
        if consecutive_splus_alarms >= sustained_windows:
            for j in range(sustained_windows):
                if i - j >= 0:
                    alarms[i - j] = True

        if consecutive_sminus_alarms >= sustained_windows:
            for j in range(sustained_windows):
                if i - j >= 0:
                    alarms[i - j] = True

    return Splus, Sminus, alarms

# --- Function: build_pairs_afpdb ---
def build_pairs_afpdb(pn_dir='afpdb'):
    """
    Builds far vs. pre-onset record pairs from the AFPDB dataset.
    A 'far' record is typically 'nX' and its 'pre-onset' counterpart is 'nXc'.
    Also validates if each record in the pair can be loaded and has 'qrs' annotations.

    Args:
        pn_dir (str, optional): The PhysioNet database directory. Defaults to 'afpdb'.

    Returns:
        list: A list of tuples, where each tuple contains (record_far_name, record_pre_name).
              Only valid pairs (loadable and with QRS annotations) are included.
    """
    all_records = wfdb.get_record_list(pn_dir)
    if not all_records:
        print(f"No records found in '{pn_dir}'.")
        return []

    valid_pairs = []
    # The AFPDB dataset uses 'nX' for control/far records and 'nXc' for pre-onset records.
    # Example: n01 (far) and n01c (pre-onset)
    # We iterate through potential 'far' records and check for their 'c' counterparts.
    for record_name in sorted(all_records):
        if record_name.endswith('c'):
            continue # Skip pre-onset records directly; they are found via their 'far' counterpart

        # Check if a 'c' counterpart exists for this 'far' record
        pre_onset_name = record_name + 'c'
        if pre_onset_name in all_records:
            # Validate both records (far and pre-onset)
            is_far_valid = False
            is_pre_valid = False

            try:
                record_far, fs_far, qrs_samples_far = load_record_and_qrs(record_name, pn_dir=pn_dir)
                if len(qrs_samples_far) > 1: # At least two QRS samples to form an RR interval
                    is_far_valid = True
            except Exception as e:
                # print(f"Warning: Record '{record_name}' (far) could not be loaded or is invalid: {e}")
                pass # Suppress detailed errors to keep output clean for validation

            try:
                record_pre, fs_pre, qrs_samples_pre = load_record_and_qrs(pre_onset_name, pn_dir=pn_dir)
                if len(qrs_samples_pre) > 1: # At least two QRS samples to form an RR interval
                    is_pre_valid = True
            except Exception as e:
                # print(f"Warning: Record '{pre_onset_name}' (pre-onset) could not be loaded or is invalid: {e}")
                pass # Suppress detailed errors

            if is_far_valid and is_pre_valid:
                valid_pairs.append({'record_far': record_name, 'record_pre': pre_onset_name})

    return valid_pairs

# --- Function: count_alarm_events ---
def count_alarm_events(alarms: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """
    Counts the number of distinct alarm events (rising edges).
    An alarm event is considered a transition from False to True.
    Consecutive True values within the 'alarms' array count as a single sustained alarm event.

    Args:
        alarms (np.ndarray): Boolean array indicating alarms (True for alarm, False otherwise).

    Returns:
        int: The number of distinct alarm events.
    """
    if len(alarms) == 0:
        return 0

    # Convert boolean array to integers (True=1, False=0)
    alarms_int = alarms.astype(int)

    # Calculate the difference between consecutive alarm states
    # A rising edge (new alarm event) is indicated by a difference of 1 (0 -> 1)
    alarm_diff = np.diff(alarms_int)

    # Count positive differences (rising edges)
    num_events = np.sum(alarm_diff == 1)

    # If the first window is an alarm, it's also an event start
    if alarms_int[0] == 1:
        num_events += 1

    return num_events

# --- Function: process_record_for_features ---
def process_record_for_features(record_name, pn_dir, h_threshold, k_threshold):
    """
    Processes a single record and extracts specified features for classification.

    Args:
        record_name (str): The name of the record to process.
        pn_dir (str): The PhysioNet database directory.
        h_threshold (float): CUSUM threshold h.
        k_threshold (float): CUSUM drift k.

    Returns:
        dict: A dictionary containing the extracted features, or None if processing fails.
    """
    try:
        record_obj, fs, qrs_samples = load_record_and_qrs(record_name, pn_dir=pn_dir)

        if len(qrs_samples) < 2: # Need at least 2 QRS for one RR interval
            return {
                'alarm_events': np.nan,
                'pct_alarm_sustained': np.nan,
                'max_cusum': np.nan,
                'final_cusum': np.nan,
                'median_rmssd': np.nan,
                'median_z': np.nan
            }

        rr_ms = compute_rr_ms(qrs_samples, fs)
        rr_time_s = np.cumsum(rr_ms / 1000.0)
        rmssd_values, _ = window_rmssd(rr_ms, rr_time_s)
        z_scores = robust_z(rmssd_values)
        Splus, Sminus, alarms_bool = cusum_bilateral(z_scores, k=k_threshold, h=h_threshold)

        # 1) alarm_events (rising edges de alarma sostenida)
        alarm_events = count_alarm_events(alarms_bool)

        # 2) pct_alarm_sustained = mean(alarm_sustained)
        pct_alarm_sustained = np.mean(alarms_bool) if len(alarms_bool) > 0 else np.nan

        # 3) max_cusum = max( max(cusum_plus), max(cusum_minus) )
        # Filter out NaN values before taking max
        valid_splus = Splus[~np.isnan(Splus)]
        valid_sminus = Sminus[~np.isnan(Sminus)]
        max_cusum = np.nan
        if len(valid_splus) > 0 and len(valid_sminus) > 0:
            max_cusum = max(np.max(valid_splus), np.max(valid_sminus))
        elif len(valid_splus) > 0:
            max_cusum = np.max(valid_splus)
        elif len(valid_sminus) > 0:
            max_cusum = np.max(valid_sminus)

        # 4) final_cusum = max( cusum_plus[-1], cusum_minus[-1] )
        final_cusum = np.nan
        if len(Splus) > 0 and len(Sminus) > 0:
            final_cusum = max(Splus[-1] if not np.isnan(Splus[-1]) else -np.inf,
                              Sminus[-1] if not np.isnan(Sminus[-1]) else -np.inf)
            if final_cusum == -np.inf: # Both were NaN
                final_cusum = np.nan
        elif len(Splus) > 0 and not np.isnan(Splus[-1]):
            final_cusum = Splus[-1]
        elif len(Sminus) > 0 and not np.isnan(Sminus[-1]):
            final_cusum = Sminus[-1]


        # 5) median_rmssd = median(rmssd_ms ignorando NaN)
        median_rmssd = np.nanmedian(rmssd_values)

        # 6) median_z = median(z_robust ignorando NaN)
        median_z = np.nanmedian(z_scores)

        return {
            'record_id': record_name,
            'alarm_events': alarm_events,
            'pct_alarm_sustained': pct_alarm_sustained,
            'max_cusum': max_cusum,
            'final_cusum': final_cusum,
            'median_rmssd': median_rmssd,
            'median_z': median_z
        }

    except Exception as e:
        # print(f"Error processing record {record_name}: {e}")
        return None # Indicate failure to process


# --- Integracion con el repo: SPC+ explainable feature set ---
from pathlib import Path
import sys


def _find_repo_root():
    candidates = [
        Path.cwd() / 'ecg v1',
        Path.cwd(),
        Path.home() / 'Documents' / 'ecg v1',
        Path(r'C:/Users/usuario/Documents/ecg v1'),
    ]
    for candidate in candidates:
        if (candidate / 'af_predict').is_dir():
            return candidate
    raise FileNotFoundError('No se encontro el repo `ecg v1`.')


REPO_ROOT = _find_repo_root()
if str(REPO_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))

from af_predict.features.windowing import window_subwindow_sqi_gate

ORIGINAL_NOTEBOOK_FEATURES = [
    'alarm_events',
    'pct_alarm_sustained',
    'max_cusum',
    'final_cusum',
    'median_rmssd',
    'median_z',
]

SPC_PLUS_ADDITIONAL_FEATURES = [
    'max_cusum_pos',
    'max_cusum_neg',
    'final_cusum_pos',
    'final_cusum_neg',
    'subwindow_sqi_good_frac',
    'rr_cv',
    'rr_masd_over_mean',
    'segment_rr_mad_ms',
]

SPC_PLUS_FULL_FEATURES = ORIGINAL_NOTEBOOK_FEATURES + SPC_PLUS_ADDITIONAL_FEATURES


def _safe_valid(values):
    arr = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    return arr[~np.isnan(arr)]


def _safe_nanmedian(values):
    arr = _safe_valid(values)
    return float(np.median(arr)) if arr.size else np.nan


def _safe_max(values):
    arr = _safe_valid(values)
    return float(np.max(arr)) if arr.size else np.nan


def _safe_last(values):
    arr = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    valid_idx = np.where(~np.isnan(arr))[0]
    return float(arr[valid_idx[-1]]) if valid_idx.size else np.nan


def _safe_max_pair(a, b):
    vals = np.asarray([a, b], dtype=float)
    vals = vals[~np.isnan(vals)]
    return float(np.max(vals)) if vals.size else np.nan


def _rr_irregularity_features(rr_ms):
    rr = _safe_valid(rr_ms)
    if rr.size == 0:
        return {
            'rr_cv': np.nan,
            'rr_masd_over_mean': np.nan,
            'segment_rr_mad_ms': np.nan,
        }

    mean_rr = float(np.mean(rr))
    rr_cv = float(np.std(rr)) / mean_rr if mean_rr > 0 else np.nan

    if rr.size >= 2 and mean_rr > 0:
        rr_masd_over_mean = float(np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(rr)))) / mean_rr
    else:
        rr_masd_over_mean = np.nan

    rr_median = float(np.median(rr))
    segment_rr_mad_ms = float(np.median(np.abs(rr - rr_median)))

    return {
        'rr_cv': rr_cv,
        'rr_masd_over_mean': rr_masd_over_mean,
        'segment_rr_mad_ms': segment_rr_mad_ms,
    }


def _cusum_branch_features(Splus, Sminus):
    return {
        'max_cusum_pos': _safe_max(Splus),
        'max_cusum_neg': _safe_max(Sminus),
        'final_cusum_pos': _safe_last(Splus),
        'final_cusum_neg': _safe_last(Sminus),
    }


def process_record_for_features_spc_plus(
    record_name,
    pn_dir,
    h_threshold,
    k_threshold,
    *,
    inner_window_sec=30.0,
    baseline_windows=10,
    sqi_gating=True,
):
    """
    Variante enriquecida ligera del notebook base.

    Mantiene las 6 features originales y anade 8 nuevas orientadas a:
    - ramas positiva/negativa del CUSUM
    - calidad de subventanas (SQI proxy)
    - irregularidad explicable en RR
    - dispersion robusta del segmento
    """
    try:
        record_obj, fs, qrs_samples = load_record_and_qrs(record_name, pn_dir=pn_dir)
        if len(qrs_samples) < 2:
            out = {feature: np.nan for feature in SPC_PLUS_FULL_FEATURES}
            out['record_id'] = record_name
            return out

        rr_ms = compute_rr_ms(qrs_samples, fs)
        rr_time_s = np.cumsum(rr_ms / 1000.0)
        rmssd_values, _ = window_rmssd(rr_ms, rr_time_s, window_sec=inner_window_sec)
        z_scores = robust_z(rmssd_values, baseline_windows=baseline_windows)

        if sqi_gating:
            gate_ok = np.asarray(
                window_subwindow_sqi_gate(rr_ms, rr_time_s, window_sec=inner_window_sec),
                dtype=bool,
            )
        else:
            gate_ok = np.ones(len(z_scores), dtype=bool)

        z_for_cusum = np.asarray(z_scores, dtype=float)
        rmssd_for_summary = np.asarray(rmssd_values, dtype=float)
        common_len = min(len(z_for_cusum), len(gate_ok), len(rmssd_for_summary)) if len(gate_ok) else 0
        if common_len > 0:
            z_for_cusum = z_for_cusum[:common_len]
            rmssd_for_summary = rmssd_for_summary[:common_len]
            gate_ok = gate_ok[:common_len]
            z_for_cusum = z_for_cusum.copy()
            z_for_cusum[~gate_ok] = np.nan
            rmssd_for_summary = rmssd_for_summary.copy()
            rmssd_for_summary[~gate_ok] = np.nan
        else:
            z_for_cusum = np.asarray([], dtype=float)
            rmssd_for_summary = np.asarray([], dtype=float)
            gate_ok = np.asarray([], dtype=bool)

        Splus, Sminus, alarms_bool = cusum_bilateral(z_for_cusum, k=k_threshold, h=h_threshold)
        branch_features = _cusum_branch_features(Splus, Sminus)
        rr_features = _rr_irregularity_features(rr_ms)

        alarm_events = count_alarm_events(alarms_bool)
        pct_alarm_sustained = float(np.mean(alarms_bool)) if len(alarms_bool) > 0 else np.nan
        max_cusum = _safe_max_pair(branch_features['max_cusum_pos'], branch_features['max_cusum_neg'])
        final_cusum = _safe_max_pair(branch_features['final_cusum_pos'], branch_features['final_cusum_neg'])
        median_rmssd = _safe_nanmedian(rmssd_for_summary)
        median_z = _safe_nanmedian(z_for_cusum)
        subwindow_sqi_good_frac = float(np.mean(gate_ok)) if len(gate_ok) > 0 else np.nan

        return {
            'record_id': record_name,
            'alarm_events': alarm_events,
            'pct_alarm_sustained': pct_alarm_sustained,
            'max_cusum': max_cusum,
            'final_cusum': final_cusum,
            'median_rmssd': median_rmssd,
            'median_z': median_z,
            'subwindow_sqi_good_frac': subwindow_sqi_good_frac,
            **branch_features,
            **rr_features,
        }
    except Exception:
        return None

5. Construccion del dataset (por pares, version SPC+ ligera)¶

Cada par contiene:

  • far (y=0)
  • pre-onset (y=1)

En esta variante se mantiene el set original del notebook y se agregan 8 features nuevas orientadas a SPC/irregularidad explicable, sin extraer el bloque no lineal pesado del repo.

Se asigna pair_id para garantizar particionado por grupos y evitar leakage.

In [6]:
# Default k/h values (not tuning them yet as per instruction)
h_feature_extraction = 7
k_feature_extraction = 0.5

# Get all valid pairs
all_afpdb_pairs = build_pairs_afpdb(pn_dir='afpdb')

# Use up to max_sets=100 pairs
max_pairs_to_process = 100
selected_pairs = all_afpdb_pairs[:min(len(all_afpdb_pairs), max_pairs_to_process)]

Xy_data_rows = []

print(f"Processing {len(selected_pairs)} pairs for SPC+ FAST feature extraction...")
print("Original notebook features:", ORIGINAL_NOTEBOOK_FEATURES)
print("Additional SPC+ features:", SPC_PLUS_ADDITIONAL_FEATURES)

for pair_idx, r_set in enumerate(selected_pairs):
    record_far_name = r_set['record_far']
    record_pre_name = r_set['record_pre']

    far_features = process_record_for_features_spc_plus(
        record_far_name,
        'afpdb',
        h_feature_extraction,
        k_feature_extraction,
    )
    if far_features is not None:
        far_features['pair_id'] = pair_idx
        far_features['y'] = 0
        Xy_data_rows.append(far_features)

    pre_features = process_record_for_features_spc_plus(
        record_pre_name,
        'afpdb',
        h_feature_extraction,
        k_feature_extraction,
    )
    if pre_features is not None:
        pre_features['pair_id'] = pair_idx
        pre_features['y'] = 1
        Xy_data_rows.append(pre_features)

Xy_df = pd.DataFrame(Xy_data_rows)
Xy_df_original6 = Xy_df[['record_id', 'pair_id', 'y'] + ORIGINAL_NOTEBOOK_FEATURES].copy()
Xy_df_spc_plus = Xy_df[['record_id', 'pair_id', 'y'] + SPC_PLUS_FULL_FEATURES].copy()

6. Modelo y evaluacion¶

Pipeline:

  1. Imputacion (SimpleImputer)
  2. Estandarizacion (StandardScaler)
  3. Regresion Logistica (LogisticRegression)

Evaluacion:

  • Split por pares para un resultado rapido.
  • GroupKFold(5) por pair_id para robustez.
  • Umbral fijo base: 0.35.
  • Mas abajo se incluye una ablacion directa entre el set original del notebook y la version SPC+ enriquecida.
In [7]:
# Separar características (X) y objetivo (y)
X = Xy_df.drop(columns=['record_id', 'pair_id', 'y'])
y = Xy_df['y']

# Split por pair_id (evita leakage)
unique_pair_ids = Xy_df['pair_id'].unique()
strat = Xy_df.groupby('pair_id')['y'].first().reindex(unique_pair_ids)

pair_id_train, pair_id_test = train_test_split(
    unique_pair_ids,
    test_size=0.30,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=strat
)

train_mask = Xy_df['pair_id'].isin(pair_id_train)
test_mask  = Xy_df['pair_id'].isin(pair_id_test)

X_train, y_train = X[train_mask], y[train_mask]
X_test,  y_test  = X[test_mask],  y[test_mask]

print("Train pairs:", len(pair_id_train), "| Test pairs:", len(pair_id_test))
print("Train rows:", X_train.shape[0], "| Test rows:", X_test.shape[0])

model_pipeline = Pipeline([
    ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")),
    ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
    ("logreg", LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=42))
])

model_pipeline.fit(X_train, y_train)

proba_test = model_pipeline.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
threshold = 0.35
pred_test = (proba_test >= threshold).astype(int)

acc = accuracy_score(y_test, pred_test)
prec1 = precision_score(y_test, pred_test, pos_label=1, zero_division=0)
rec1 = recall_score(y_test, pred_test, pos_label=1, zero_division=0)
f11 = f1_score(y_test, pred_test, pos_label=1, zero_division=0)
cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, pred_test)

print(f"Test @thr={threshold:.2f} | acc={acc:.4f} | prec1={prec1:.4f} | rec1={rec1:.4f} | f1_1={f11:.4f}")
print("Confusion matrix:")
print(cm)

7. Validación cruzada GroupKFold (5 folds)¶

Se reportan métricas por fold y resumen (media ± desviación estándar).

In [8]:
# Construir X, y, groups
X = Xy_df.drop(columns=['record_id', 'pair_id', 'y'])
y = Xy_df['y']
groups = Xy_df['pair_id']

gkf = GroupKFold(n_splits=5)
threshold = 0.35

accuracy_scores = []
precision_1_scores = []
recall_1_scores = []
f1_1_scores = []

fold_rows = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(gkf.split(X, y, groups=groups), start=1):
    X_tr, X_va = X.iloc[train_idx], X.iloc[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_va = y.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[val_idx]
    g_tr, g_va = groups.iloc[train_idx], groups.iloc[val_idx]

    # Verificación anti-leakage
    assert set(g_tr.unique()).isdisjoint(set(g_va.unique())), "Leakage: un pair_id aparece en train y val."

    pipe = clone(model_pipeline)
    pipe.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

    proba = pipe.predict_proba(X_va)[:, 1]
    pred = (proba >= threshold).astype(int)

    acc = accuracy_score(y_va, pred)
    prec1 = precision_score(y_va, pred, pos_label=1, zero_division=0)
    rec1 = recall_score(y_va, pred, pos_label=1, zero_division=0)
    f11 = f1_score(y_va, pred, pos_label=1, zero_division=0)

    accuracy_scores.append(acc)
    precision_1_scores.append(prec1)
    recall_1_scores.append(rec1)
    f1_1_scores.append(f11)

    fold_rows.append({"fold": fold, "accuracy": acc, "precision_1": prec1, "recall_1": rec1, "f1_1": f11})

cv_results = pd.DataFrame(fold_rows)
cv_summary = pd.DataFrame([
    {"metric": "accuracy", "mean": np.mean(accuracy_scores), "std": np.std(accuracy_scores, ddof=1)},
    {"metric": "precision_1", "mean": np.mean(precision_1_scores), "std": np.std(precision_1_scores, ddof=1)},
    {"metric": "recall_1", "mean": np.mean(recall_1_scores), "std": np.std(recall_1_scores, ddof=1)},
    {"metric": "f1_1", "mean": np.mean(f1_1_scores), "std": np.std(f1_1_scores, ddof=1)},
])

display(cv_results.round(4))
display(cv_summary.round(4))

Gráficas simples para ver variación entre folds.

In [9]:
metrics = ['accuracy', 'precision_1', 'recall_1', 'f1_1']
for metric_name in metrics:
    plt.figure(figsize=(7, 4))
    plt.plot(cv_results['fold'], cv_results[metric_name], marker='o')
    mean_value = cv_summary.loc[cv_summary['metric']==metric_name, 'mean'].iloc[0]
    plt.axhline(mean_value, linestyle='--')
    plt.title(f"{metric_name.replace('_',' ').title()} por fold (GroupKFold)")
    plt.xlabel("Fold")
    plt.ylabel(metric_name)
    plt.xticks(cv_results['fold'])
    plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

9. Discusion y siguientes pasos (para formato paper)¶

  • Ablacion principal: comparar el set original de 6 features contra el set SPC+ ligero.
  • Calibracion: evaluar sensibilidad al umbral (0.35) y curvas PR/ROC.
  • Robustez: repetir con distintos seeds en el split por pares (sin tuning).
  • Trazabilidad: registrar version de dependencias y hashes de archivos procesados.
  • Evaluacion clinica avanzada: al final del notebook ya queda integrada la capa del repo para CV, bootstrap, benchmark e interpretabilidad.
In [ ]:

9.1 Ablacion: set original del notebook vs SPC+ ligero¶

In [10]:
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

X_original = Xy_df[ORIGINAL_NOTEBOOK_FEATURES].copy()
X_spc_plus = Xy_df[SPC_PLUS_FULL_FEATURES].copy()
y = Xy_df['y'].copy()
groups = Xy_df['pair_id'].copy()

gkf = GroupKFold(n_splits=5)
threshold = 0.35

print("=" * 78)
print("ABLATION STUDY: Original notebook feature set vs SPC+ lightweight set")
print("=" * 78)

original_rows = []
spc_plus_rows = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(gkf.split(X_original, y, groups=groups), start=1):
    y_tr = y.iloc[train_idx]
    y_va = y.iloc[val_idx]

    X_original_tr = X_original.iloc[train_idx]
    X_original_va = X_original.iloc[val_idx]
    pipe_original = clone(model_pipeline)
    pipe_original.fit(X_original_tr, y_tr)
    proba_original = pipe_original.predict_proba(X_original_va)[:, 1]
    pred_original = (proba_original >= threshold).astype(int)

    original_rows.append({
        'fold': fold,
        'model': 'Original_6',
        'accuracy': accuracy_score(y_va, pred_original),
        'precision': precision_score(y_va, pred_original, pos_label=1, zero_division=0),
        'recall': recall_score(y_va, pred_original, pos_label=1, zero_division=0),
        'f1': f1_score(y_va, pred_original, pos_label=1, zero_division=0),
        'roc_auc': roc_auc_score(y_va, proba_original),
    })

    X_spc_plus_tr = X_spc_plus.iloc[train_idx]
    X_spc_plus_va = X_spc_plus.iloc[val_idx]
    pipe_spc_plus = clone(model_pipeline)
    pipe_spc_plus.fit(X_spc_plus_tr, y_tr)
    proba_spc_plus = pipe_spc_plus.predict_proba(X_spc_plus_va)[:, 1]
    pred_spc_plus = (proba_spc_plus >= threshold).astype(int)

    spc_plus_rows.append({
        'fold': fold,
        'model': 'SPC_Fast_14',
        'accuracy': accuracy_score(y_va, pred_spc_plus),
        'precision': precision_score(y_va, pred_spc_plus, pos_label=1, zero_division=0),
        'recall': recall_score(y_va, pred_spc_plus, pos_label=1, zero_division=0),
        'f1': f1_score(y_va, pred_spc_plus, pos_label=1, zero_division=0),
        'roc_auc': roc_auc_score(y_va, proba_spc_plus),
    })

    print(
        f"Fold {fold} | Original AUC={original_rows[-1]['roc_auc']:.4f}/F1={original_rows[-1]['f1']:.4f} "
        f"| SPC+ AUC={spc_plus_rows[-1]['roc_auc']:.4f}/F1={spc_plus_rows[-1]['f1']:.4f}"
    )

ablation_per_fold = pd.DataFrame(original_rows + spc_plus_rows)
ablation_summary = (
    ablation_per_fold
    .groupby('model')[['accuracy', 'precision', 'recall', 'f1', 'roc_auc']]
    .agg(['mean', 'std'])
)

print()
print("Per-fold ablation results:")
display(ablation_per_fold.round(4))
print()
print("Ablation summary:")
display(ablation_summary.round(4))

mean_original = pd.DataFrame(original_rows)[['accuracy', 'precision', 'recall', 'f1', 'roc_auc']].mean()
mean_spc_plus = pd.DataFrame(spc_plus_rows)[['accuracy', 'precision', 'recall', 'f1', 'roc_auc']].mean()
improvement = (mean_spc_plus - mean_original).rename('delta_spc_plus_minus_original').to_frame()

9.2 Calibración: Sensibilidad al Umbral y Curvas PR/ROC¶

In [11]:
# Threshold sensitivity analysis and ROC/PR curves
from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, auc, precision_recall_curve, average_precision_score

X = Xy_df.drop(columns=['record_id', 'pair_id', 'y'])
y = Xy_df['y']
groups = Xy_df['pair_id']

# Use test set from earlier for threshold analysis
proba_test_full = model_pipeline.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Evaluate multiple thresholds
thresholds_to_test = np.arange(0.1, 1.0, 0.05)
threshold_results = []

for thr in thresholds_to_test:
    pred = (proba_test_full >= thr).astype(int)
    acc = accuracy_score(y_test, pred)
    prec = precision_score(y_test, pred, pos_label=1, zero_division=0)
    rec = recall_score(y_test, pred, pos_label=1, zero_division=0)
    f1 = f1_score(y_test, pred, pos_label=1, zero_division=0)
    threshold_results.append({
        'threshold': thr,
        'accuracy': acc,
        'precision': prec,
        'recall': rec,
        'f1': f1
    })

threshold_df = pd.DataFrame(threshold_results)

# ROC and PR curves
fpr, tpr, roc_thresholds = roc_curve(y_test, proba_test_full)
roc_auc = auc(fpr, tpr)

precision_vals, recall_vals, pr_thresholds = precision_recall_curve(y_test, proba_test_full)
pr_auc = average_precision_score(y_test, proba_test_full)

# Visualize threshold sensitivity
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))

# 1. Threshold vs metrics
ax = axes[0, 0]
ax.plot(threshold_df['threshold'], threshold_df['accuracy'], label='Accuracy', marker='o')
ax.plot(threshold_df['threshold'], threshold_df['precision'], label='Precision', marker='s')
ax.plot(threshold_df['threshold'], threshold_df['recall'], label='Recall', marker='^')
ax.plot(threshold_df['threshold'], threshold_df['f1'], label='F1-score', marker='d')
ax.axvline(0.35, color='red', linestyle='--', label='Default (0.35)')
ax.set_xlabel('Threshold')
ax.set_ylabel('Score')
ax.set_title('Threshold Sensitivity Analysis (Test Set)')
ax.legend()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. ROC curve
ax = axes[0, 1]
ax.plot(fpr, tpr, label=f'ROC (AUC={roc_auc:.4f})', linewidth=2)
ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', label='Random')
ax.set_xlabel('False Positive Rate')
ax.set_ylabel('True Positive Rate')
ax.set_title('ROC Curve')
ax.legend()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. PR curve
ax = axes[1, 0]
ax.plot(recall_vals, precision_vals, label=f'PR (AUC={pr_auc:.4f})', linewidth=2)
ax.set_xlabel('Recall')
ax.set_ylabel('Precision')
ax.set_title('Precision-Recall Curve')

# 4. Table of threshold metrics

ax.axis('tight')
ax.axis('off')
table_data = threshold_df.round(4).head(10).values

9.3 Robustez: Múltiples Seeds en el Split por Pares¶

In [12]:
# Robustness analysis: repeat pair split with different random seeds
X = Xy_df.drop(columns=['record_id', 'pair_id', 'y'])
y = Xy_df['y']
groups_all = Xy_df['pair_id']

seeds_to_test = [42, 123, 456, 789, 999]
threshold = 0.35

robustness_results = []

print("=" * 70)
print("ROBUSTNESS: Evaluating with Multiple Seeds (NO Model Tuning)")
print("=" * 70)

for seed in seeds_to_test:
    unique_pair_ids = Xy_df['pair_id'].unique()
    strat = Xy_df.groupby('pair_id')['y'].first().reindex(unique_pair_ids)
    
    pair_id_train, pair_id_test = train_test_split(
        unique_pair_ids,
        test_size=0.30,
        random_state=seed,
        stratify=strat
    )
    
    train_mask = Xy_df['pair_id'].isin(pair_id_train)
    test_mask = Xy_df['pair_id'].isin(pair_id_test)
    
    X_train_seed = X[train_mask]
    y_train_seed = y[train_mask]
    X_test_seed = X[test_mask]
    y_test_seed = y[test_mask]
    
    # Train and evaluate
    model_seed = Pipeline([
        ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")),
        ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
        ("logreg", LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=seed))
    ])
    
    model_seed.fit(X_train_seed, y_train_seed)
    proba_test_seed = model_seed.predict_proba(X_test_seed)[:, 1]
    pred_test_seed = (proba_test_seed >= threshold).astype(int)
    
    acc = accuracy_score(y_test_seed, pred_test_seed)
    prec = precision_score(y_test_seed, pred_test_seed, pos_label=1, zero_division=0)
    rec = recall_score(y_test_seed, pred_test_seed, pos_label=1, zero_division=0)
    f1 = f1_score(y_test_seed, pred_test_seed, pos_label=1, zero_division=0)
    
    robustness_results.append({
        'seed': seed,
        'train_pairs': len(pair_id_train),
        'test_pairs': len(pair_id_test),
        'accuracy': acc,
        'precision': prec,
        'recall': rec,
        'f1': f1
    })
    
    print(f"Seed {seed}: Acc={acc:.4f}, Prec={prec:.4f}, Rec={rec:.4f}, F1={f1:.4f}")

robustness_df = pd.DataFrame(robustness_results)

# Summary statistics
metrics_cols = ['accuracy', 'precision', 'recall', 'f1']
summary_stats = robustness_df[metrics_cols].describe().round(4)

print("\nRobustness Summary Statistics across seeds:")
display(summary_stats)

# Visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))

# Boxplot
ax = axes[0]
robustness_df[metrics_cols].plot(kind='box', ax=ax)
ax.set_title('Distribution of Metrics Across Seeds')
ax.set_ylabel('Score')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Line plot per seed
ax = axes[1]
for metric in metrics_cols:
    ax.plot(robustness_df['seed'], robustness_df[metric], marker='o', label=metric)
ax.set_xlabel('Random Seed')
ax.set_ylabel('Score')
ax.set_title('Metrics Stability across Seeds')
ax.legend()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("\nDetailed results per seed:")
display(robustness_df.round(4))

import sys
import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime

# Capture environment and dependency information for reproducibility
traceability_log = {
    'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
    'python_version': sys.version,
    'dependencies': {},
    'key_files_hashes': {}
}

# Log key dependencies
import_packages = ['numpy', 'pandas', 'scipy', 'sklearn', 'wfdb', 'matplotlib']
for pkg_name in import_packages:
    try:
        pkg = __import__(pkg_name)
        version = getattr(pkg, '__version__', 'unknown')
        traceability_log['dependencies'][pkg_name] = version
    except ImportError:
        traceability_log['dependencies'][pkg_name] = 'not installed'

# Compute hash of AFPDB files if they exist
print("=" * 70)
print("TRACEABILITY LOG: Environment & File Integrity")
print("=" * 70)

def compute_file_hash(filepath, hash_algo='sha256'):
    """Compute SHA256 hash of a file."""
    hasher = hashlib.sha256()
    try:
        with open(filepath, 'rb') as f:
            while chunk := f.read(8192):
                hasher.update(chunk)
        return hasher.hexdigest()
    except (FileNotFoundError, PermissionError) as e:
        return f"error: {e}"

# List and hash key AFPDB files
afpdb_dir = 'afpdb'
if os.path.exists(afpdb_dir):
    hea_files = [f for f in os.listdir(afpdb_dir) if f.endswith('.hea')]
    print(f"\nFound {len(hea_files)} .hea files in {afpdb_dir}")
    
    # Hash a few representative files
    sample_files = sorted(hea_files)[:5]  # First 5 files
    for hea_file in sample_files:
        filepath = os.path.join(afpdb_dir, hea_file)
        file_hash = compute_file_hash(filepath)
        traceability_log['key_files_hashes'][hea_file] = file_hash[:16] + '...'  # Abbreviated
    
    # Also check .dat and .qrs files
    dat_files = [f for f in os.listdir(afpdb_dir) if f.endswith('.dat')]
    qrs_files = [f for f in os.listdir(afpdb_dir) if f.endswith('.qrs')]
    traceability_log['dataset_files_count'] = {
        'hea': len(hea_files),
        'dat': len(dat_files),
        'qrs': len(qrs_files)
    }
    print(f"  .hea files: {len(hea_files)}")
    print(f"  .dat files: {len(dat_files)}")
    print(f"  .qrs files: {len(qrs_files)}")
else:
    print(f"\n{afpdb_dir} directory not found.")
    traceability_log['dataset_files_count'] = 'N/A'

# Display dependency versions
print("\nDependency Versions:")
for pkg_name, version in traceability_log['dependencies'].items():
    print(f"  {pkg_name}: {version}")

# Create reproducibility document
print("\nKey Model Hyperparameters:")
print(f"  CUSUM threshold (h): {h_feature_extraction}")
print(f"  CUSUM drift (k): {k_feature_extraction}")
print(f"  Classification threshold: {threshold}")
print(f"  LogisticRegression max_iter: 1000")
print(f"  LogisticRegression random_state: 42 (baseline)")
print(f"  GroupKFold splits: 5")
print(f"  Train/Test split ratio: 70/30")

# Export traceability log as JSON-like text
print("\nTraceability Log (JSON format):")
print(json.dumps(traceability_log, indent=2, default=str))

# Optional: Save to file
log_filename = 'traceability_log.json'
with open(log_filename, 'w') as f:
    json.dump(traceability_log, f, indent=2, default=str)
print(f"\nTraceability log saved to: {log_filename}")

10. Integracion del repo: evaluacion clinica avanzada¶

Esta seccion reutiliza utilidades del repo ecg v1 para dejar el notebook mas fuerte y mas util para reporte:

  • auditoria automatica de features
  • GroupKFold con threshold tuning OOF sin fuga directa sobre validacion
  • tabla paper-ready con resumen robusto de metricas
  • benchmark entre modelos base
  • auditoria de validacion anti-leakage
  • interpretabilidad cuantitativa de la regresion logistica

Nota: se mantiene intacta tu extraccion original de features. Lo nuevo se monta encima del Xy_df ya construido.

def _find_repo_root() -> Path:
    candidates = [
        Path.cwd() / "ecg v1",
        Path.cwd(),
        Path.home() / "Documents" / "ecg v1",
        Path(r"C:/Users/usuario/Documents/ecg v1"),
    ]
    for candidate in candidates:
        if (candidate / "af_predict").is_dir():
            return candidate
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        "No se encontro el repo `ecg v1` con el paquete `af_predict`."
    )

10.2 Evaluacion clinica con GroupKFold y threshold tuning OOF¶

Se usa la regresion logistica del repo con imputacion, escalado y class_weight='balanced'. Cuando hay grupos suficientes, el umbral se ajusta dentro del train usando OOF y GroupKFold interno.

In [16]:
n_groups = int(groups_repo.nunique())
outer_splits = min(5, n_groups)
outer_cv = GroupKFold(n_splits=outer_splits)

if n_groups >= 6:
    inner_splits = min(3, n_groups - 1)
    inner_cv = GroupKFold(n_splits=inner_splits)
    clinical_eval_kwargs = {
        "threshold_selection": "f1",
        "inner_cv": inner_cv,
        "min_recall_floor": 0.80,
    }
    threshold_policy_used = "OOF threshold tuning (f1) dentro de train"
else:
    inner_cv = None
    clinical_eval_kwargs = {"threshold": 0.35}
    threshold_policy_used = "threshold fijo = 0.35 (fallback por pocos grupos)"

logreg_balanced = make_estimator("logreg", random_state=42, class_weight="balanced")

clinical_eval = group_kfold_clinical_evaluation(
    logreg_balanced,
    X_repo,
    y_repo,
    groups_repo,
    outer_cv,
    **clinical_eval_kwargs,
)

if isinstance(threshold_meta, dict):
    clinical_threshold = float(threshold_meta.get("mean_threshold", 0.5))

benchmark_models = {
    "LogReg_balanced": make_estimator("logreg", random_state=42, class_weight="balanced"),
    "RandomForest_balanced": make_estimator("rf", random_state=42, class_weight="balanced"),
    "SVM_RBF_balanced": make_estimator("svm", random_state=42, class_weight="balanced"),
}

benchmark_rows = []
benchmark_outputs = {}

for model_name, estimator in benchmark_models.items():
    benchmark_eval = group_kfold_clinical_evaluation(
        estimator,
        X_repo,
        y_repo,
        groups_repo,
        outer_cv,
        **clinical_eval_kwargs,

    benchmark_outputs[model_name] = benchmark_eval
    metric_map = benchmark_eval["summary_dataframe"].set_index("metric")["mean"].to_dict()
    benchmark_rows.append(
        {
            "model": model_name,
            "roc_auc": metric_map.get("roc_auc", np.nan),
            "pr_auc": metric_map.get("pr_auc", np.nan),
            "balanced_accuracy": metric_map.get("balanced_accuracy", np.nan),
            "f1": metric_map.get("f1", np.nan),
            "recall": metric_map.get("recall", np.nan),
            "specificity": metric_map.get("specificity", np.nan),

10.4 Auditoria de validacion, bootstrap por grupos y estabilidad entre seeds¶

Esta auditoria resume tres cosas:

  • integridad de folds por pair_id
  • bootstrap por grupos para IC de AUC/F1/recall
  • repeticion con distintas semillas para ver estabilidad de metricas
In [18]:

4. Riesgos de leakage (lista de comprobaciÃ³n)¶

  • NormalizaciÃ³n, imputaciÃ³n o selecciÃ³n de variables ajustadas solo en train por fold; nunca estadÃ­sticas globales (media/varianza) calculadas con test.
  • Si hay varios ECG por paciente, el agrupamiento debe ser a nivel paciente (o unidad clÃ­nica); pair_id solo es vÃ¡lido si no mezcla informaciÃ³n del outcome entre train y test.
  • Criterios de exclusiÃ³n, outliers o recorte de seÃ±al no deben usar etiquetas del conjunto de validaciÃ³n.
  • Optimizar hiperparÃ¡metros o umbral solo dentro del train (p. ej. OOF) o en un hold-out separado; ajustar el umbral en el propio val del fold sesga optimÃ­sticamente.
  • Bootstrap y tests de significancia: preferir remuestreo por paciente (implementado aquÃ­), no por latidos o ventanas i.i.d.
  • CorrelaciÃ³n entre folds: las mÃ©tricas por fold no son independientes; los IC bootstrap por grupos sobre predicciones CV son una aproximaciÃ³n Ãºtil pero no sustituyen cohortes externas.

10.7 Fold-level error analysis¶

Analisis descriptivo y diagnostico del fold de peor desempeno bajo el mismo protocolo de GroupKFold y ajuste de threshold usado en la evaluacion principal. Esta seccion no trata los folds como observaciones IID ni usa pruebas de hipotesis ingenuas entre folds: sirve para debugging serio, interpretacion y preparacion de hipotesis futuras.

In [21]:
from collections import Counter

from sklearn.calibration import calibration_curve
from sklearn.metrics import brier_score_loss

from af_predict.evaluation.metrics import compute_fold_metrics
from af_predict.evaluation.threshold import (
    _default_inner_cv,
    oof_positive_proba,
    resolve_threshold_from_strategy,
)

PRIMARY_FOLD_ANALYSIS_MODEL = "LogReg_balanced"
FOLD_ANALYSIS_CONFIG = {
    "selection_metric": "f1",
    "max_feature_plots": 6,
    "ambiguous_top_n": 10,
    "high_confidence_top_n": 10,
    "margin_near_threshold": 0.10,
    "high_confidence_margin": 0.25,
}
LOWER_IS_BETTER_METRICS = {"brier", "false_alarm_rate", "fp", "fn"}

FOLD_ANALYSIS_FEATURES = [
    feature
    for feature in (
        interpret_full["feature"].tolist()
        if "interpret_full" in globals()
        else list(feature_cols_repo)
    )
    if feature in feature_cols_repo
][: FOLD_ANALYSIS_CONFIG["max_feature_plots"]]
if not FOLD_ANALYSIS_FEATURES:
    FOLD_ANALYSIS_FEATURES = list(feature_cols_repo[: FOLD_ANALYSIS_CONFIG["max_feature_plots"]])


def _iloc_safe(X, idx):
    return X.iloc[idx] if hasattr(X, "iloc") else X[idx]


def _positive_proba(model, X, proba_positive_index=1):
    proba = model.predict_proba(X)
    if np.ndim(proba) == 1:
        return np.asarray(proba, dtype=float).ravel()
    return np.asarray(proba[:, proba_positive_index], dtype=float).ravel()


def _resolve_fold_threshold(
    estimator,
    X_train,
    y_train,
    groups_train,
    *,
    threshold=0.5,
    threshold_selection=None,
    inner_cv=None,
    min_recall_floor=0.9,
    proba_positive_index=1,
):
    if threshold_selection is None:
        return float(threshold)
    inner = inner_cv if inner_cv is not None else _default_inner_cv()
    oof_scores = oof_positive_proba(
        estimator,
        X_train,
        y_train,
        inner,
        groups=groups_train,
        proba_positive_index=proba_positive_index,
    )
    return float(
        resolve_threshold_from_strategy(
            y_train,
            oof_scores,
            threshold_selection,
            min_recall_floor=min_recall_floor,
        )
    )


def _extract_linear_component(model):
    if hasattr(model, "named_steps"):
        for step_name in reversed(list(model.named_steps.keys())):
            step = model.named_steps[step_name]
            if hasattr(step, "coef_"):
                return step_name, step
    if hasattr(model, "coef_"):
        return "estimator", model
    return None, None


def _error_type_from_arrays(y_true, y_pred):
    conditions = [
        (y_true == 1) & (y_pred == 1),
        (y_true == 0) & (y_pred == 0),
        (y_true == 0) & (y_pred == 1),
        (y_true == 1) & (y_pred == 0),
    ]
    return np.select(conditions, ["TP", "TN", "FP", "FN"], default="UNK")


def collect_groupkfold_artifacts(
    model_name,
    estimator,
    X,
    y,
    groups,
    cv,
    *,
    row_meta,
    feature_cols,
    threshold=0.5,
    threshold_selection=None,
    inner_cv=None,
    min_recall_floor=0.9,
    proba_positive_index=1,
):
    groups_arr = np.asarray(groups).ravel()
    fold_metric_rows = []
    prediction_frames = []
    coefficient_frames = []

    for fold_id, (train_idx, test_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(X, y, groups=groups), start=1):
        X_train = _iloc_safe(X, train_idx)
        X_test = _iloc_safe(X, test_idx)
        y_train = np.asarray(_iloc_safe(y, train_idx), dtype=int).ravel()
        y_test = np.asarray(_iloc_safe(y, test_idx), dtype=int).ravel()
        groups_train = groups_arr[train_idx]
        groups_test = groups_arr[test_idx]

        assert set(np.unique(groups_train)).isdisjoint(set(np.unique(groups_test))), (
            f"Leakage detectado en fold {fold_id}: un group aparece en train y test."
        )

        fitted = clone(estimator)
        fitted.fit(X_train, y_train)
        y_prob = _positive_proba(fitted, X_test, proba_positive_index=proba_positive_index)
        threshold_used = _resolve_fold_threshold(
            estimator,
            X_train,
            y_train,
            groups_train,
            threshold=threshold,
            threshold_selection=threshold_selection,
            inner_cv=inner_cv,
            min_recall_floor=min_recall_floor,
            proba_positive_index=proba_positive_index,
        )
        y_pred = (y_prob >= threshold_used).astype(int)

        metric_row = compute_fold_metrics(y_test, y_pred, y_prob)
        metric_row.update(
            {
                "fold": fold_id,
                "fold_id": fold_id,
                "model_name": model_name,
                "threshold_used": float(threshold_used),
                "n_test": int(len(test_idx)),
                "n_groups_test": int(np.unique(groups_test).size),
            }
        )
        fold_metric_rows.append(metric_row)

        meta_test = row_meta.iloc[test_idx].copy().reset_index().rename(columns={"index": "observation_index"})
        feature_test = _iloc_safe(X, test_idx)
        if hasattr(feature_test, "loc"):
            feature_test = feature_test.loc[:, feature_cols].reset_index(drop=True)
        else:
            feature_test = pd.DataFrame(feature_test, columns=feature_cols)

        fold_predictions = pd.concat([meta_test.reset_index(drop=True), feature_test], axis=1)
        fold_predictions["model_name"] = model_name
        fold_predictions["fold"] = fold_id
        fold_predictions["fold_id"] = fold_id
        fold_predictions["y_true"] = y_test
        fold_predictions["y_pred"] = y_pred
        fold_predictions["y_prob"] = y_prob
        fold_predictions["threshold_used"] = float(threshold_used)
        fold_predictions["margin_signed"] = fold_predictions["y_prob"] - float(threshold_used)
        fold_predictions["margin_abs"] = fold_predictions["margin_signed"].abs()
        fold_predictions["is_error"] = fold_predictions["y_true"] != fold_predictions["y_pred"]
        fold_predictions["is_correct"] = ~fold_predictions["is_error"]
        fold_predictions["error_type"] = _error_type_from_arrays(
            fold_predictions["y_true"].to_numpy(),
            fold_predictions["y_pred"].to_numpy(),
        )
        prediction_frames.append(fold_predictions)

        _, linear_component = _extract_linear_component(fitted)
        if linear_component is not None and hasattr(linear_component, "coef_"):
            coef_values = np.asarray(linear_component.coef_, dtype=float).ravel()
            if coef_values.shape[0] == len(feature_cols):
                coefficient_frames.append(
                    pd.DataFrame(
                        {
                            "model_name": model_name,
                            "fold": fold_id,
                            "fold_id": fold_id,
                            "feature": list(feature_cols),
                            "coefficient": coef_values,
                            "abs_coefficient": np.abs(coef_values),
                            "intercept": float(np.asarray(linear_component.intercept_, dtype=float).ravel()[0]),
                        }
                    )
                )

    fold_metrics_df = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {k: v for k, v in row.items() if k != "confusion_matrix"}
            for row in fold_metric_rows
        ]
    ).sort_values("fold_id").reset_index(drop=True)
    fold_predictions_df = pd.concat(prediction_frames, ignore_index=True)
    fold_coefficients_df = (
        pd.concat(coefficient_frames, ignore_index=True)
        if coefficient_frames
        else pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["model_name", "fold", "fold_id", "feature", "coefficient", "abs_coefficient", "intercept"]
        )
    )
    confusion_by_fold = {
        row["fold_id"]: row["confusion_matrix"]
        for row in fold_metric_rows
    }

    return {
        "fold_metrics_df": fold_metrics_df,
        "fold_predictions_df": fold_predictions_df,
        "fold_coefficients_df": fold_coefficients_df,
        "confusion_by_fold": confusion_by_fold,
    }


def select_worst_fold(fold_metrics_df, metric_name="f1"):
    if metric_name not in fold_metrics_df.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"La metrica {metric_name!r} no existe en fold_metrics_df.")
    ascending = metric_name not in LOWER_IS_BETTER_METRICS
    return (
        fold_metrics_df.sort_values([metric_name, "fold_id"], ascending=[ascending, True])
        .iloc[0]
        .copy()
    )


def _iqr(values):
    series = pd.Series(values).dropna()
    if series.empty:
        return np.nan
    return float(series.quantile(0.75) - series.quantile(0.25))


def _cohens_d(group_a, group_b):
    a = pd.Series(group_a).dropna().astype(float)
    b = pd.Series(group_b).dropna().astype(float)
    if len(a) < 2 or len(b) < 2:
        return np.nan
    var_a = float(a.var(ddof=1))
    var_b = float(b.var(ddof=1))
    pooled = ((len(a) - 1) * var_a + (len(b) - 1) * var_b) / max(len(a) + len(b) - 2, 1)
    if pooled <= 0:
        return np.nan
    return float((b.mean() - a.mean()) / np.sqrt(pooled))


def summarize_feature_groups(df, feature_cols, group_col):
    rows = []
    for feature in feature_cols:
        for group_value, series in df.groupby(group_col)[feature]:
            series = series.dropna().astype(float)
            rows.append(
                {
                    "comparison": group_col,
                    "feature": feature,
                    "group": group_value,
                    "n": int(series.shape[0]),
                    "mean": float(series.mean()) if not series.empty else np.nan,
                    "median": float(series.median()) if not series.empty else np.nan,
                    "std": float(series.std(ddof=1)) if len(series) > 1 else np.nan,
                    "iqr": _iqr(series),
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def summarize_feature_effects(df, feature_cols, group_col, group_a, group_b, comparison_name):
    rows = []
    for feature in feature_cols:
        a = df.loc[df[group_col] == group_a, feature].dropna().astype(float)
        b = df.loc[df[group_col] == group_b, feature].dropna().astype(float)
        pooled_iqr = np.nanmean([_iqr(a), _iqr(b)])
        median_diff = float(b.median() - a.median()) if (not a.empty and not b.empty) else np.nan
        rows.append(
            {
                "comparison": comparison_name,
                "feature": feature,
                "group_a": group_a,
                "group_b": group_b,
                "n_group_a": int(a.shape[0]),
                "n_group_b": int(b.shape[0]),
                "mean_group_a": float(a.mean()) if not a.empty else np.nan,
                "mean_group_b": float(b.mean()) if not b.empty else np.nan,
                "median_group_a": float(a.median()) if not a.empty else np.nan,
                "median_group_b": float(b.median()) if not b.empty else np.nan,
                "std_group_a": float(a.std(ddof=1)) if len(a) > 1 else np.nan,
                "std_group_b": float(b.std(ddof=1)) if len(b) > 1 else np.nan,
                "iqr_group_a": _iqr(a),
                "iqr_group_b": _iqr(b),
                "median_diff_group_b_minus_group_a": median_diff,
                "standardized_median_diff": float(median_diff / pooled_iqr) if np.isfinite(pooled_iqr) and pooled_iqr > 0 else np.nan,
                "cohens_d_group_b_minus_group_a": _cohens_d(a, b),
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def plot_feature_boxplots(df, feature_cols, group_col, label_order, title_prefix):
    if not feature_cols:
        return
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(len(feature_cols), 1, figsize=(8, max(3.0, 2.8 * len(feature_cols))), squeeze=False)
    for ax, feature in zip(axes.ravel(), feature_cols):
        series_list = [df.loc[df[group_col] == label, feature].dropna().astype(float).to_numpy() for label in label_order]
        if not any(len(values) for values in series_list):
            ax.set_visible(False)
            continue
        ax.boxplot(
            [values if len(values) else np.array([np.nan]) for values in series_list],
            labels=[str(label) for label in label_order],
            showfliers=True,
            patch_artist=True,
        )
        ax.set_title(f"{title_prefix}: {feature}")
        ax.set_ylabel(feature)
        ax.grid(True, alpha=0.25)
    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

selected_features = FOLD_ANALYSIS_FEATURES[: FOLD_ANALYSIS_CONFIG["max_feature_plots"]]
worst_fold_feature_summary_by_class_df = summarize_feature_groups(
    worst_fold_predictions_df,
    selected_features,
    "y_true",
)
worst_fold_feature_summary_by_outcome_df = summarize_feature_groups(
    worst_fold_predictions_df,
    selected_features,
    "prediction_outcome",
)
worst_fold_feature_effects_class_df = summarize_feature_effects(
    worst_fold_predictions_df,
    selected_features,
    "y_true",
    0,
    1,
    "positive_vs_negative",
).sort_values("cohens_d_group_b_minus_group_a", key=lambda s: s.abs(), ascending=False)
worst_fold_feature_effects_outcome_df = summarize_feature_effects(
    worst_fold_predictions_df,
    selected_features,
    "prediction_outcome",
    "correct",
    "error",
    "error_vs_correct",
).sort_values("cohens_d_group_b_minus_group_a", key=lambda s: s.abs(), ascending=False)

optional_error_pair_frames = []
if {"FP", "TN"}.issubset(set(worst_fold_predictions_df["error_type"])):
    optional_error_pair_frames.append(
        summarize_feature_effects(
            worst_fold_predictions_df,
            selected_features,
            "error_type",
            "TN",
            "FP",
            "fp_vs_tn",
        )
    )
if {"FN", "TP"}.issubset(set(worst_fold_predictions_df["error_type"])):
    optional_error_pair_frames.append(
        summarize_feature_effects(
            worst_fold_predictions_df,
            selected_features,
            "error_type",
            "TP",
            "FN",
            "fn_vs_tp",
        )
    )
worst_fold_feature_effects_error_type_df = (
    pd.concat(optional_error_pair_frames, ignore_index=True)
    if optional_error_pair_frames
    else pd.DataFrame()
)

display(worst_fold_feature_summary_by_class_df.round(4))
display(worst_fold_feature_summary_by_outcome_df.round(4))
display(worst_fold_feature_effects_class_df.round(4))
display(worst_fold_feature_effects_outcome_df.round(4))
if not worst_fold_feature_effects_error_type_df.empty:
    display(worst_fold_feature_effects_error_type_df.round(4))

plot_feature_boxplots(
    worst_fold_predictions_df,
    selected_features,
    "y_true",
    [0, 1],
    title_prefix=f"Worst fold {worst_fold_id} by true class",
)
plot_feature_boxplots(
    worst_fold_predictions_df,
    selected_features,
    "prediction_outcome",
    ["correct", "error"],
    title_prefix=f"Worst fold {worst_fold_id} by prediction outcome",
)

worst_fold_brier = float(brier_score_loss(worst_fold_predictions_df["y_true"], worst_fold_predictions_df["y_prob"]))
calibration_bins = int(max(3, min(6, worst_fold_predictions_df["y_prob"].nunique(), len(worst_fold_predictions_df) // 4 if len(worst_fold_predictions_df) >= 8 else 3)))
calibration_curve_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["mean_predicted_prob", "observed_positive_rate"])

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.5, 4.0))
axes[0].hist(worst_fold_predictions_df["y_prob"], bins=min(12, max(4, len(worst_fold_predictions_df))), color="#4c72b0", alpha=0.8)
axes[0].axvline(worst_fold_row["threshold_used"], color="red", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.2, label=f"thr={worst_fold_row['threshold_used']:.3f}")
axes[0].set_title(f"Predicted probability histogram (fold {worst_fold_id})")
axes[0].set_xlabel("Predicted probability")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Count")
axes[0].grid(True, alpha=0.25)
axes[0].legend()

if worst_fold_predictions_df["y_true"].nunique() >= 2 and worst_fold_predictions_df["y_prob"].nunique() >= 2:
    observed_pos, mean_pred = calibration_curve(
        worst_fold_predictions_df["y_true"],
        worst_fold_predictions_df["y_prob"],
        n_bins=calibration_bins,
        strategy="quantile",
    )
    calibration_curve_df = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "mean_predicted_prob": mean_pred,
            "observed_positive_rate": observed_pos,
        }
    )
    axes[1].plot([0, 1], [0, 1], linestyle="--", color="black", linewidth=1.0, label="perfect calibration")
    axes[1].plot(mean_pred, observed_pos, marker="o", linewidth=2.0, color="#dd8452", label="fold reliability")
    axes[1].set_title(f"Reliability-style plot (fold {worst_fold_id})")
    axes[1].set_xlabel("Mean predicted probability")
    axes[1].set_ylabel("Observed positive rate")
    axes[1].grid(True, alpha=0.25)
    axes[1].legend()
else:
    axes[1].text(0.5, 0.5, "No hay variacion suficiente para curva de calibracion.", ha="center", va="center")
    axes[1].set_axis_off()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

worst_fold_calibration_summary_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "fold_id": [worst_fold_id],
        "brier": [worst_fold_brier],
        "mean_predicted_probability": [float(worst_fold_predictions_df["y_prob"].mean())],
        "observed_positive_rate": [float(worst_fold_predictions_df["y_true"].mean())],
        "threshold_used": [float(worst_fold_row["threshold_used"])],
        "n_bins": [calibration_bins],
    }
)
display(worst_fold_calibration_summary_df.round(4))
if not calibration_curve_df.empty:
    display(calibration_curve_df.round(4))

variant_metric_cols = [
    "model_name",
    "source",
    "fold_id",
    "roc_auc",
    "f1",
    "recall",
    "specificity",
    "balanced_accuracy",
    "brier",
    "fp",
    "fn",
    "threshold_used",
]
worst_fold_variant_comparison_df = (
    available_variant_per_fold_df.loc[available_variant_per_fold_df["fold_id"] == worst_fold_id, variant_metric_cols]
    .sort_values(
        [selection_metric, "roc_auc"],
        ascending=[selection_metric in LOWER_IS_BETTER_METRICS, False],
        na_position="last",
    )
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)
display(worst_fold_variant_comparison_df.round(4))

logreg_coef_stability_df = pd.DataFrame()
if not fold_coefficients_df.empty:
    worst_coef = fold_coefficients_df.loc[fold_coefficients_df["fold_id"] == worst_fold_id, ["feature", "coefficient"]].rename(
        columns={"coefficient": "coefficient_worst_fold"}
    )
    other_coef = fold_coefficients_df.loc[fold_coefficients_df["fold_id"] != worst_fold_id].copy()
    logreg_coef_stability_df = worst_coef.merge(
        other_coef.groupby("feature")["coefficient"].agg(["mean", "std", "median"]),
        left_on="feature",
        right_index=True,
        how="left",
    ).rename(
        columns={
            "mean": "coefficient_other_folds_mean",
            "std": "coefficient_other_folds_std",
            "median": "coefficient_other_folds_median",
        }
    )
    sign_reference = (
        other_coef.assign(sign=np.sign(other_coef["coefficient"]))
        .groupby("feature")["sign"]
        .agg(lambda s: Counter(s).most_common(1)[0][0] if len(s) else np.nan)
        .rename("majority_sign_other_folds")
    )
    logreg_coef_stability_df = logreg_coef_stability_df.merge(sign_reference, left_on="feature", right_index=True, how="left")
    logreg_coef_stability_df["delta_vs_other_mean"] = (
        logreg_coef_stability_df["coefficient_worst_fold"]
        - logreg_coef_stability_df["coefficient_other_folds_mean"]
    )
    logreg_coef_stability_df["sign_worst_fold"] = np.sign(logreg_coef_stability_df["coefficient_worst_fold"])
    logreg_coef_stability_df["sign_flip_vs_majority"] = (
        logreg_coef_stability_df["sign_worst_fold"]
        != logreg_coef_stability_df["majority_sign_other_folds"]
    )
    logreg_coef_stability_df = logreg_coef_stability_df.sort_values(
        "delta_vs_other_mean",
        key=lambda s: s.abs(),
        ascending=False,
    ).reset_index(drop=True)
    display(logreg_coef_stability_df.round(4))

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.0, 4.2))
    coef_plot_df = logreg_coef_stability_df.head(12).iloc[::-1]
    ax.barh(coef_plot_df["feature"], coef_plot_df["delta_vs_other_mean"], color="#8172b3")
    ax.axvline(0.0, color="black", linewidth=1.0)
    ax.set_title(f"Worst-fold coefficient drift vs other folds (fold {worst_fold_id})")
    ax.set_xlabel("Coefficient delta vs mean(other folds)")
    ax.grid(True, axis="x", alpha=0.25)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

predominant_error_type = (
    worst_fold_error_counts_df.sort_values(["n", "error_type"], ascending=[False, True]).iloc[0]["error_type"]
    if not worst_fold_error_counts_df.empty
    else "unknown"
)
error_total = int(worst_fold_predictions_df["is_error"].sum())
near_threshold_share = float(
    worst_fold_predictions_df.loc[worst_fold_predictions_df["is_error"], "margin_abs"]
    .lt(FOLD_ANALYSIS_CONFIG["margin_near_threshold"])
    .mean()
) if error_total else 0.0
high_conf_error_share = float(
    worst_fold_predictions_df.loc[worst_fold_predictions_df["is_error"], "margin_abs"]
    .ge(FOLD_ANALYSIS_CONFIG["high_confidence_margin"])
    .mean()
) if error_total else 0.0
group_error_concentration = float(
    worst_fold_pair_summary_df["n_errors"].head(3).sum() / error_total
) if error_total else 0.0
median_abs_class_effect = float(
    worst_fold_feature_effects_class_df["cohens_d_group_b_minus_group_a"].abs().median()
) if not worst_fold_feature_effects_class_df.empty else np.nan

best_alternative_msg = "No hubo comparacion suficiente entre variantes/modelos."
if not worst_fold_variant_comparison_df.empty:
    main_row = worst_fold_variant_comparison_df.loc[
        worst_fold_variant_comparison_df["model_name"] == PRIMARY_FOLD_ANALYSIS_MODEL
    ]
    if not main_row.empty:
        main_value = float(main_row.iloc[0][selection_metric])
        if selection_metric in LOWER_IS_BETTER_METRICS:
            better_alternatives = worst_fold_variant_comparison_df.loc[
                worst_fold_variant_comparison_df[selection_metric] < main_value
            ]
        else:
            better_alternatives = worst_fold_variant_comparison_df.loc[
                worst_fold_variant_comparison_df[selection_metric] > main_value
            ]
        better_alternatives = better_alternatives.loc[
            better_alternatives["model_name"] != PRIMARY_FOLD_ANALYSIS_MODEL
        ]
        if not better_alternatives.empty:
            best_alt = better_alternatives.iloc[0]
            best_alternative_msg = (
                f"La variante/modelo que mejor rescata este fold es {best_alt['model_name']} "
                f"(source={best_alt['source']}) con {selection_metric}={best_alt[selection_metric]:.4f}."
            )
        else:
            best_alternative_msg = "Ninguna variante disponible supera claramente al modelo principal en este fold."

stability_msg = "No hubo coeficientes por fold para analizar estabilidad."
if not logreg_coef_stability_df.empty:
    sign_flips = int(logreg_coef_stability_df["sign_flip_vs_majority"].sum())
    stability_msg = (
        f"Se observaron {sign_flips} features con cambio de signo respecto a la mayoria de los otros folds."
        if sign_flips
        else "Los signos de los coeficientes se mantienen estables entre folds; la variacion es mas de magnitud que de direccion."
    )

diagnostic_hypotheses = []
if np.isfinite(median_abs_class_effect) and median_abs_class_effect < 0.40:
    diagnostic_hypotheses.append("menor separabilidad de features entre clases reales dentro del fold dificil")
if near_threshold_share >= 0.60:
    diagnostic_hypotheses.append("muchos errores cerca del threshold, consistente con ambiguedad o calibracion local")
if high_conf_error_share >= 0.30:
    diagnostic_hypotheses.append("existen errores de alta confianza, consistente con representacion insuficiente, shift de grupo o no linealidad")
if group_error_concentration >= 0.50:
    diagnostic_hypotheses.append("los errores se concentran en pocos pair_id, sugiriendo heterogeneidad por grupo")
if not diagnostic_hypotheses:
    diagnostic_hypotheses.append("el patron de fallo parece mixto; conviene revisar grupos, calibracion y separabilidad en conjunto")

top_conflictive_pairs = ", ".join(
    [
        f"pair_id={int(row.pair_id)} (errors={int(row.n_errors)})"
        for row in worst_fold_pair_summary_df.head(3).itertuples()
        if int(row.n_errors) > 0
    ]
) or "sin concentracion clara por pair_id"

suggested_next_steps = [
    "auditar manualmente los pair_id con mas errores y revisar calidad/representatividad de sus segmentos",
    "probar futura recalibracion nested train-only o threshold policies alternativas sin tocar el test fold",
    "evaluar features adicionales o transformaciones no lineales si persisten errores de alta confianza",
]
if "rescata" in best_alternative_msg:
    suggested_next_steps.append("usar este fold como caso piloto para hipotesis de ensamble o gating entre modelos")

fold_diagnostic_summary_md = f"""
#### Automatic diagnostic summary

- Worst fold selected by `{selection_metric}`: **fold {worst_fold_id}** with value **{worst_fold_row[selection_metric]:.4f}**.
- Error profile: predominant error type = **{predominant_error_type}**; total errors = **{error_total}**; Brier score = **{worst_fold_brier:.4f}**.
- Conflictive groups: {top_conflictive_pairs}.
- Margin view: near-threshold error share = **{near_threshold_share:.2%}**; high-confidence error share = **{high_conf_error_share:.2%}**.
- Feature/separability signal: median |Cohen's d| for positive vs negative = **{median_abs_class_effect:.4f}**.
- Interpretation: {'; '.join(diagnostic_hypotheses)}.
- Variant/model comparison: {best_alternative_msg}
- Coefficient stability: {stability_msg}
- Suggested next steps: {'; '.join(suggested_next_steps)}.
"""
display(Markdown(fold_diagnostic_summary_md))

Automatic diagnostic summary¶

  • Worst fold selected by f1: fold 2 with value 0.8000.
  • Error profile: predominant error type = TP; total errors = 9; Brier score = 0.1663.
  • Conflictive groups: pair_id=98 (errors=2), pair_id=68 (errors=1), pair_id=3 (errors=1).
  • Margin view: near-threshold error share = 44.44%; high-confidence error share = 44.44%.
  • Feature/separability signal: median |Cohen's d| for positive vs negative = 0.6839.
  • Interpretation: existen errores de alta confianza, consistente con representacion insuficiente, shift de grupo o no linealidad.
  • Variant/model comparison: La variante/modelo que mejor rescata este fold es SPC_Fast_14 (source=ablation_feature_sets) con f1=0.8372.
  • Coefficient stability: Se observaron 1 features con cambio de signo respecto a la mayoria de los otros folds.
  • Suggested next steps: auditar manualmente los pair_id con mas errores y revisar calidad/representatividad de sus segmentos; probar futura recalibracion nested train-only o threshold policies alternativas sin tocar el test fold; evaluar features adicionales o transformaciones no lineales si persisten errores de alta confianza; usar este fold como caso piloto para hipotesis de ensamble o gating entre modelos.
